Option Explicit

Private Function Shown(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    On Error Resume Next
    If IsError(v) Then
        Shown = CStr(v)
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        Shown = "array"
    Else
        Shown = TypeName(v) & ":" & CStr(v)
    End If
End Function

Private Function Listed(ByVal v As Variant) As String
    Dim i As Long, s As String
    If IsEmpty(v) Then
        Listed = "none"
        Exit Function
    End If
    For i = LBound(v) To UBound(v)
        s = s & "," & v(i)
    Next
    Listed = LBound(v) & ":" & Mid(s, 2)
End Function

Private Function State(ByVal d As Object) As String
    Dim s As String, cell As Range, entry As Name, b As Workbook
    On Error Resume Next
    For Each cell In d.Worksheets(1).Range("A1:A6").Cells
        s = s & "|" & cell.Formula & "=" & Shown(cell.Value)
    Next
    For Each entry In d.Names
        s = s & "|" & entry.Name & "->" & entry.RefersTo
    Next
    s = s & "|links " & Listed(d.LinkSources(xlExcelLinks))
    For Each b In Workbooks
        If b.Name <> ThisWorkbook.Name Then s = s & "|open " & b.Name & IIf(b.ReadOnly, " ro", "")
    Next
    s = s & "|active " & IIf(ActiveWorkbook.Name = ThisWorkbook.Name, "harness", ActiveWorkbook.Name)
    State = s
End Function

Private Sub Shut()
    Dim b As Workbook, again As Boolean
    On Error Resume Next
    Do
        again = False
        For Each b In Workbooks
            If b.Name <> ThisWorkbook.Name Then
                b.Close False
                again = True
                Exit For
            End If
        Next
    Loop While again
End Sub

Public Function Tried(ByVal which As Long, ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim d As Object, p As Object, r As Variant, s As String
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Application.AskToUpdateLinks = False
    Set p = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\Plain.xlsx", 0)
    Set d = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\Dest.xlsx", 0)
    Dim links As Variant
    links = d.LinkSources(xlExcelLinks)
    On Error GoTo Failed
    Run which, d, p, folder, r
    s = "ok " & Shown(r)
Answered:
    On Error GoTo 0
    Tried = s & State(d)
    Shut
    Exit Function
Failed:
    s = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description
    Resume Answered
End Function

Private Sub Run(ByVal which As Long, d As Object, p As Object, ByVal folder As String, r As Variant)
    Dim l As Object
    Select Case which
    Case 0
        r = 0
    Case 1
        d.UpdateLink
    Case 2
        r = d.UpdateLink
    Case 3
        d.UpdateLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 4
        r = d.UpdateLink(folder & "\Alpha.xlsx")
    Case 5
        d.UpdateLink Name:=folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", Type:=xlExcelLinks
    Case 6
        d.UpdateLink Name:=folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", Type:=xlOLELinks
    Case 7
        d.UpdateLink folder & "\Beta.xlsx"
    Case 8
        d.UpdateLink "Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 9
        d.UpdateLink "ALPHA.XLSX"
    Case 10
        d.UpdateLink UCase(folder & "\Alpha.xlsx")
    Case 11
        d.UpdateLink Array(folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Beta.xlsx")
    Case 12
        d.UpdateLink Array(folder & "\Alpha.xlsx")
    Case 13
        d.UpdateLink "Nope.xlsx"
    Case 14
        d.UpdateLink ""
    Case 15
        d.UpdateLink folder & "\Nope.xlsx"
    Case 16
        d.UpdateLink 5
    Case 17
        d.UpdateLink Null
    Case 18
        d.UpdateLink Empty
    Case 19
        d.UpdateLink Type:=xlExcelLinks
    Case 20
        d.UpdateLink Type:=xlOLELinks
    Case 21
        d.UpdateLink Type:=7
    Case 22
        d.UpdateLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", 7
    Case 23
        d.UpdateLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", "x"
    Case 24
        d.UpdateLink d.LinkSources
    Case 25
        d.UpdateLink d.LinkSources(xlExcelLinks)
    Case 26
        d.BreakLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", xlExcelLinks: d.UpdateLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 27
        Workbooks.Open folder & "\Alpha.xlsx": d.UpdateLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 28
        p.UpdateLink
    Case 29
        p.UpdateLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 30
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 31
        r = d.ChangeLink(folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx")
    Case 32
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx", xlLinkTypeExcelLinks
    Case 33
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx", xlLinkTypeOLELinks
    Case 34
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx", 7
    Case 35
        d.ChangeLink "Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 36
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", "Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 37
        d.ChangeLink UCase(folder & "\Alpha.xlsx"), folder & "\Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 38
        d.ChangeLink "Nope.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 39
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Nope.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 40
        d.ChangeLink "", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 41
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", ""
    Case 42
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 43
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 44
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Beta.xlsx"
    Case 45
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Beta.xlsx", folder & "\Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 46
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", d.FullName
    Case 47
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", 5
    Case 48
        d.ChangeLink 5, folder & "\Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 49
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx": d.ChangeLink folder & "\Gamma.xlsx", folder & "\Beta.xlsx"
    Case 50
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx": d.ChangeLink folder & "\Beta.xlsx", folder & "\Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 51
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx": d.UpdateLink folder & "\Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 52
        d.BreakLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", xlExcelLinks: d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 53
        Workbooks.Open folder & "\Gamma.xlsx": d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 54
        Workbooks.Open folder & "\Alpha.xlsx": d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 55
        p.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 56
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx": d.Save: d.Close False: Set d = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\Dest.xlsx", 0)
    Case 57
        d.OpenLinks folder & "\Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 58
        r = d.OpenLinks(folder & "\Alpha.xlsx")
    Case 59
        d.OpenLinks Name:=folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", ReadOnly:=True
    Case 60
        d.OpenLinks Name:=folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", ReadOnly:=False
    Case 61
        d.OpenLinks folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", , xlExcelLinks
    Case 62
        d.OpenLinks folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", , xlOLELinks
    Case 63
        d.OpenLinks folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", , 7
    Case 64
        d.OpenLinks "Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 65
        d.OpenLinks UCase(folder & "\Alpha.xlsx")
    Case 66
        d.OpenLinks Array(folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Beta.xlsx")
    Case 67
        d.OpenLinks d.LinkSources
    Case 68
        d.OpenLinks "Nope.xlsx"
    Case 69
        d.OpenLinks ""
    Case 70
        d.OpenLinks
    Case 71
        d.OpenLinks 5
    Case 72
        d.OpenLinks folder & "\Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 73
        Workbooks.Open folder & "\Alpha.xlsx": d.OpenLinks folder & "\Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 74
        d.BreakLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", xlExcelLinks: d.OpenLinks folder & "\Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 75
        p.OpenLinks folder & "\Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 76
        d.OpenLinks folder & "\Alpha.xlsx": Workbooks("Dest.xlsx").Activate
    Case 77
        d.OpenLinks Array(folder & "\Beta.xlsx", folder & "\Alpha.xlsx")
    Case 78
        d.SetLinkOnData folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", "Macro"
    Case 79
        r = d.SetLinkOnData(folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", "Macro")
    Case 80
        d.SetLinkOnData folder & "\Alpha.xlsx"
    Case 81
        d.SetLinkOnData "Nope"
    Case 82
        d.SetLinkOnData
    Case 83
        d.SetLinkOnData folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", ""
    Case 84
        p.SetLinkOnData "Nope", "Macro"
    Case 85
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Missing.xlsx"
    Case 86
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Other.xlsx"
    Case 87
        Set l = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\Lost.xlsx", 0): r = l.LinkSources(xlExcelLinks)(1): l.UpdateLink folder & "\Gone.xlsx"
    Case 88
        Set l = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\Lost.xlsx", 0): r = l.LinkSources(xlExcelLinks)(1): l.OpenLinks folder & "\Gone.xlsx"
    Case 89
        Set l = Workbooks.Open(folder & "\Lost.xlsx", 0): r = l.LinkSources(xlExcelLinks)(1): l.ChangeLink folder & "\Gone.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx": r = l.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value
    Case 90
        d.OpenLinks folder & "\Alpha.xlsx": Workbooks("Alpha.xlsx").Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = 5000
    Case 91
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Gamma.xlsx": d.SaveCopyAs folder & "\Copy.xlsx"
    Case 92
        Workbooks.Open folder & "\Alpha.xlsx": Set l = Workbooks("Alpha.xlsx"): r = l.Close(False)
    Case 93
        d.UpdateLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx": d.Save
    Case 94
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Beta.xlsx": d.Save
    Case 95
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Other.xlsx": d.Save
    Case 96
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", folder & "\Missing.xlsx": d.Save
    Case 97
        d.OpenLinks folder & "\Alpha.xlsx": d.Save
    Case 98
        d.ChangeLink folder & "\Alpha.xlsx", "C:\Windows\Gamma.xlsx": d.Save
    Case 99
        p.UpdateLink Type:=xlExcelLinks
    Case 100
        p.OpenLinks folder & "\Gamma.xlsx"
    Case 101
        p.OpenLinks folder & "\Gamma.xlsx", , xlExcelLinks
    End Select
End Sub

Private Sub Saved(ByVal b As Workbook, ByVal path As String)
    b.SaveAs path, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    b.Close False
End Sub

Private Function Sheet(ByVal folder As String, ByVal name As String, ByVal sheetName As String, ByVal first As Double) As Workbook
    Dim b As Workbook, i As Long
    Set b = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    b.Worksheets(1).Name = sheetName
    For i = 1 To 3
        b.Worksheets(1).Cells(i, 1).Value = first * i
    Next
    b.Names.Add Name:="Rate", RefersTo:="=" & sheetName & "!$A$1"
    b.SaveAs folder & "\" & name, xlOpenXMLWorkbook
    Set Sheet = b
End Function

Private Sub LostBook(ByVal folder As String)
    Dim gone As Workbook, l As Workbook
    Set gone = Sheet(folder, "Gone.xlsx", "Sheet1", 2)
    Set l = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    l.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Formula = "=[Gone.xlsx]Sheet1!A1"
    Saved l, folder & "\Lost.xlsx"
    gone.Close False
    Kill folder & "\Gone.xlsx"
End Sub

Public Function Setup(ByVal folder As String) As String
    Dim alpha As Workbook, beta As Workbook, d As Workbook, ws As Worksheet, p As Workbook
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    Set alpha = Sheet(folder, "Alpha.xlsx", "Sheet1", 1)
    Set beta = Sheet(folder, "Beta.xlsx", "Sheet1", 10)
    Sheet(folder, "Gamma.xlsx", "Sheet1", 7).Close False
    Sheet(folder, "Other.xlsx", "Elsewhere", 3).Close False
    Set p = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    p.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = 1
    Saved p, folder & "\Plain.xlsx"
    Set d = Workbooks.Add(xlWBATWorksheet)
    Set ws = d.Worksheets(1)
    ws.Name = "Dest"
    d.Names.Add Name:="Ext", RefersTo:="=[Alpha.xlsx]Sheet1!$A$1:$A$3"
    ws.Range("A1").Formula = "=[Alpha.xlsx]Sheet1!A1"
    ws.Range("A2").Formula = "=[Beta.xlsx]Sheet1!A1"
    ws.Range("A3").Formula = "=[Alpha.xlsx]Sheet1!A2+[Beta.xlsx]Sheet1!A2"
    ws.Range("A4").Formula = "=SUM(Ext)"
    ws.Range("A5").Formula = "=[Alpha.xlsx]Sheet1!A3*2"
    ws.Range("A6").Value = 5
    Saved d, folder & "\Dest.xlsx"
    LostBook folder
    beta.Close False
    alpha.Worksheets(1).Range("A1").Value = 100
    alpha.Worksheets(1).Range("A2").Value = 200
    alpha.Save
    alpha.Close False
    Setup = "done"
End Function
